data.text: Insurance renewal agent: gather (dec page) -> shop (3 mock insurers via AgentMail) -> compare -> leverage current insurer -> human e-signs -> cancel old after bind. Submit by 16:30 PT.
3-min demo: dec page -> graph, live agent-to-agent quote emails, leak guard blocks a message, comparison table, sign handoff, savings counter.
TypeScript monorepo. Mastra agents, Neon AI Gateway for models, AgentMail for email, Exa for market research, Next.js + assistant-ui for UI, SQLite locally for the personal graph.
Every fact has disclosure: hidden | private (agent may use, never say) | shareable. Private facts never reach channel agents.
Strategist (sees private limits, outputs decisions only) vs channel agents (email/voice; never see limits). Leak guard checks every outgoing message.
Agent never binds, signs or pays. Insurer sends e-sign doc; human signs. Old policy cancelled only after new one is confirmed.
